transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I suppose... well, my daughter thought I should come. Since my grandson was... killed. She sits right beside me, holding my hand, and... I know I love her. I know I do. But I just... I can't feel the warmth of it inside me anymore. Not at all.
When did you first notice you couldn't feel the warmth of love inside you anymore?
About six days. Just... ever since he was killed. Outside the community center. It's been six days.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time since your grandson passed away?
I don't know. I... I don't think I feel sad, exactly. I just... I'm not really sure.
Are you able to enjoy things you normally like to do?
I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't tried doing much of anything. So I couldn't say.
Are you able to find pleasure in things you used to enjoy before your grandson passed away?
I... I think you just asked me that. I really couldn't tell you. I haven't... I haven't done anything to find out.
Have you lost interest in activities you normally enjoy?
I... I just don't know. Like I said, I haven't been doing much. So I couldn't tell you if I've lost interest or not.
Do you feel hopeless about the future?
I... I haven't really thought about it. I don't look that far ahead right now. So... I just don't know.
Do you feel guilty about your grandson's death?
No... I don't think so. I just... no, I don't.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite since your grandson passed away?
No... I don't think it's changed. I haven't really been paying much attention to it. I just... I eat what I need to, I suppose.
Have you felt like doing things you used to enjoy before your grandson passed away?
I... I haven't really tried. I just do what needs to be done around the house. I haven't really thought about doing much else right now.
Do you feel depressed?
I... I wouldn't really know. I just... I feel like I'm just trying to get through the days. I haven't really thought about it like that.
How long have you felt like you can't feel the warmth of love inside you?
About six days, I suppose. Ever since... well, since he was killed. Out by the community center. I just... I haven't really felt much of anything since then.
Are you able to experience pleasure when something good happens?

I don't think so. I just... I can't. Even when my daughter comes over... she can sit right beside me, holding my hand, and... I know I love her. I do. But I just cannot feel the warmth of it inside me at all.
Have you lost or gained any weight since your grandson passed away?
I... I haven't noticed. I don't really know. I haven't looked at a scale or... paid attention to that.
Can you think of anything that you have enjoyed or found pleasurable since your grandson passed away?
No... I don't think so. Like I was just saying about my daughter, I just... I can't feel any of that warmth anymore. Not since he was killed. There's just... nothing.
Have you felt a lack of interest in activities that normally bring you pleasure since your grandson passed away?
I... I don't really know. I suppose I just... haven't tried to do much of anything lately. So I couldn't really say.
Have you had a period of two weeks or more where you felt depressed or lost interest in things?
I... I don't really know. I haven't been keeping track of the days or the weeks. I couldn't really say.
How many days have you been feeling this way?
It's been... six days. Since it happened. Since he was killed outside the community center. Just six days.
Have you felt like doing things you normally enjoy is not as appealing to you since your grandson passed away?
I... I think I already said, I just haven't really tried to do anything. I haven't even thought about what I enjoy right now. I just... I don't know.
Have you felt depressed for most of the day, nearly every day, since your grandson passed away?
I'm not sure. I haven't really thought about it like that... I just haven't been paying much attention to how I feel.
